title: Project package in 'src/' folder is not added to python path after install
body:
<!-- Checked checkbox should look like this: [x] -->
- [x] I am on the [latest](https://github.com/python-poetry/poetry/releases/latest) Poetry version. (Prerelease!)
- [x] I have searched the [issues](https://github.com/python-poetry/poetry/issues) of this repo and believe that this is not a duplicate.
- [x] If an exception occurs when executing a command, I executed it again in debug mode (`-vvv` option). No poetry exception

Running `Windows 10 Pro` with `Ubuntu 18.04.4 LTS` inside Windows Subsystem for Linux, with ZSH.

```
Poetry
Version: 1.1.0a3
Python:  3.6.9

Virtualenv
Python:         3.6.9
Implementation: CPython
Path:           /home/bouke/.cache/pypoetry/virtualenvs/betterproto-1OFIV5Qo-py3.6
Valid:          True

System
Platform: linux
OS:       posix
Python:   /usr
```
- **Link of a [Gist](https://gist.github.com/) with the contents of your pyproject.toml file**: https://github.com/danielgtaylor/python-betterproto/blob/master/pyproject.toml

## Issue

- After running `poetry install`, the project package itself is not added to python path.
- Our package is in `src/`, and defined in `pyproject.toml` to be included as `betterproto` (may or may not be related)

## Reproduce:

clone `betterproto`
```bash
git clone git@github.com:danielgtaylor/python-betterproto.git poetry-install-bug
cd poetry-install-bug
git checkout cbd34370803a537743f6cdcadb9e5893781b137d
```

install poetry
```bash 
poetry run pip install --upgrade pip  # workaround for another bug, probably not essential to reproduce
poetry install
```

run a module that depends on the project package `betterproto`
```bash
poetry run python -m tests.generate
# ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'betterproto'
```
